notes: The registered C row permits every level at POS_DEAD; the focused test pins the authoritative entry gate (R1/R2/R5e).
An empty argument defaults to 100, consumes one C-compatible number draw, and emits actor plus room bytes (R1/R3/R5e).
A positive decimal max is used inclusively for the single draw and in both output ranges (R1/R3/R5e).
one_argument consumes only the first non-fill token; trailing words do not alter the max (R1/R2/R5e).
atoi zero selects the C default 100 rather than a clamped range of 1 (R1/R3/R5e).
A token with no leading digits follows atoi's zero result and still draws/emits both C lines (R1/R3/R5e).
atoi stops at the first non-digit, so 6junk selects max 6 and preserves draw order (R1/R3/R5e).
C one_argument skips the fill word the before consuming 6 (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
C atoi accepts an optional leading plus sign and selects max 6 (R1/R3/R5e).
The reachable -5 edge converts max_roll to unsigned 4294967291, then to int -5 for number; the unsigned result/output bytes are preserved (R1/R3/R5e).
Each draw emits the actor line and the distinct room line to the observer (R1/R3/R5e).
